name: healthrecordloginuat
description: Health record login/upload - standalone UAT (Cloudflare Pages + R2)

scripts.create-bucket: node run-wrangler.cjs r2 bucket create healthrecordloginuat-uploads
scripts.create-project: node run-wrangler.cjs pages project create healthrecordloginuat --production-branch main
scripts.deploy: node run-wrangler.cjs pages deploy public --project-name healthrecordloginuat --branch main
